html:
American animator and film producer who built the Disney entertainment empire. Born in Chicago, he grew up partly on a farm in Missouri and started in animation in Kansas City.

In 1923 he and his brother Roy started a studio in Los Angeles, near the young Hollywood film industry. Its milestones:

  • 1928: Mickey Mouse, drawn with Ub Iwerks, starred in Steamboat Willie, one of the first cartoons with synchronised sound.
  • 1937: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, the first full-length cel-animated feature film, became a huge hit.
  • 1940s: Pinocchio, Fantasia and Bambi, and training and propaganda films in World War II.
  • 1950s: television shows and nature films.
  • 1955: Disneyland opened in California, a new kind of theme park.

He won more Academy Awards than anyone else. He was also a hard boss who fought a strike by his animators in 1941. He died in 1966, before Walt Disney World in Florida opened.
sum: American animator and film producer who built the Disney entertainment empire. Born in Chicago, he grew up partly on a farm in Missouri and started in animation in Kansas City.
